notes:
Culture dossier, one page. The spread years (5300 Rhine-Elbe, 5200 Paris Basin and Dniester) are this dossier's placements inside the page's "360 years" and "about 5200 BC" for the Netherlands. Overlaps: the Lengyel (from 5000 BCE) and Cucuteni-Trypillia (from 4800 BCE) take land in mid-life; Rössen (c. 4600 BC), Hinkelstein, Grossgartach, Michelsberg, Chasséen and the Tisza culture have no dossiers, so the Rhine and Alföld after 4500/4940 BCE are nobody's land until the Funnelbeaker (4100 BCE). Gazetteer: "Transdanubia", "Alföld", "Paris Basin" are not regions; lists of admin-1 units stand in.

Repair 2026-10-18 (after the reviewer): Moravia (Jihomoravsky, Zlinsky, Olomoucky, Moravskoslezsky) is subtracted from the keyframes from 5000 BCE and from the dissolve region, because the Lengyel holds it from 5000 BCE (Lengyel page: Austrian/Moravian Painted Ware). The keyframe from 5000 BCE is split at 4940 BCE: the first part keeps the Alfold units so that the 4940 loss removes them (LBK page: 'flourished until about 4940'); the new keyframe linear-pottery-culture_-4940 follows. The Dniester loss of 4800 BCE is split: Moldova, Chernivtsi, Khmel'nyts'kyy, Ternopil' and Vinnytsya go to cucuteni-trypillia-culture (inside its first shape), L'viv, Ivano-Frankivs'k, Volyn and Rivne to nobody (both confidence 1). New loss in 4500 BCE to lengyel-culture for Bohemia and central Poland (confidence 1, page silent), mirroring lengyel-culture's gain: the Lengyel no longer draws these from 5000 BCE, because the Stroked Pottery culture ('5000-4500 BC') holds them. Pages re-read 2026-10-18: Linear Pottery culture, Bug-Dniester culture (does not mention the LBK; dates 6300-5000 BC), Cucuteni-Trypillia culture (names the LBK only as an influence 'from the north' in the fifth millennium). The arrival on the Rhine, Elbe, Oder and Vistula (ledger 5300 BCE) stays confidence 1: the page gives '1,500 km in 360 years' and the Netherlands 'at about 5200 BC', nothing for these rivers. The page's own Czech/Polish places: Bohemia and Moravia appear only as LBK origin regions, Oslonki is a late LBK site.
